feature_name: Gemini in Looker Explore summaries and analyses
summary: Gemini in Looker can generate summaries and analyses of Explores.
extended_definition: Gemini in Looker can generate summaries and analyses of Explores.

supporting_pages.title: Admin settings \u2013 Gemini in Looker \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: AI-Assisted Quick Starts — enables the Gemini-generated Quick Start analyses for a Looker Explore.

To generate Explore summaries, including the suggested purpose of the Explore and the types of data that are used in the query, you must have a role that contains the develop permission for at least one model in the LookML project and the explore permission to view and interact with Explores.
Explore NL Summary — allows users to view a Gemini-generated summary of a Looker Explore .

supporting_pages.title: AND/OR Filters in Explores \_|\_ Looker \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Home Documentation Data analytics Looker Send feedback AND/OR Filters in Explores Stay organized with collections Save and categorize content based on your preferences.
AND/OR filters on dashboards AND/OR filters are created in the Explore Filters section and are translated into Looker expressions before the query is run.
Limitations The following are limitations for AND/OR filters in Explores: Multiple filters default to using AND filter logic.

supporting_pages.title: Admin settings - General settings \_|\_ Looker \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: When it is enabled, any Looker admin user will be emailed when a new Looker account is created. ( Signed embed users are an exception; emails are not generated when a signed embed user is created.) The email will contain the new user's email address.

The status of the Automated Gemini in Looker enablement and user management setting affects the group as follows: If you enable the setting: New users who are added to the instance are added to the group automatically.

When Visual Drilling is enabled, the drill overlays for Looks and Explores consider the underlying data to select the best visualization type, which can be a table visualization or some other visualization type.
